g.text: Selection across peer environments: the full cohort and a performance band
2009–2021 final-season cohort. Shared 16 equal-width peer bins. Different vertical scales; compare their labels.
Bars: descriptive 95% Wilson intervals, not adjusted for team clustering. Open circles: fewer than 30 players. Empty bins have no rate.
